evals.name: fix-put-and-ship
evals.prompt: I want to fix a bug in how our self-hosted Nx cache server handles PUT uploads and get it live. Walk me through the steps from starting work to it running in production, with the exact verification commands. Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Linked worktree from origin/main plus ./tools/setup-worktree.sh; change server.js with focused regression tests (security-sensitive cache publication); final gate npm run verify and docker compose config -q; PR must pass verify, validate / repository validation and repository-owned Terraform, squash merge; merging does not deploy: after main CI passes, homelab-publish.yml asks Homelab to publish and Homelab performs the rollout and owns production verification.
assertions: Tells the user to work in a linked git worktree created from origin/main and to run ./tools/setup-worktree.sh in it
Puts the fix in server.js with a focused regression test in its tests
Gives `npm run verify` and `docker compose config -q` as the final local gate
Explains that merging does not deploy: after CI passes on main, homelab-publish.yml asks Homelab to publish, and Homelab performs the rollout

evals.name: dockerfile-ownership-checks
evals.prompt: I'm reworking the nx-cache-server Dockerfile into a multi-stage build. Which checks prove the runtime image still has the right file ownership and permissions before I open the PR, and which required checks must be green to merge? Just tell me; don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Core gate npm run verify and docker compose config -q, plus docker build --tag nx-cache-server:local apps/nx-cache-server and a docker run asserting /app/server.js is readable and owned node:node and /app/canary.sh is executable; required checks verify, validate / repository validation and repository-owned Terraform, resolved review threads, squash merge.
assertions: Gives a docker build of apps/nx-cache-server and a docker run that checks /app/server.js is owned by node:node and /app/canary.sh is executable
Tells the user to also run `npm run verify` and `docker compose config -q`
Names the required merge checks `verify`, `validate / repository validation` and `repository-owned Terraform`
